headline: Amazon Gets Out of the MMO Game
summary: Amazon is completely exiting the MMO gaming space. The company is handing over live operations for Throne and Liberty and Lost Ark. This move follows a strategic shift away from first-party AAA MMO development.

headline: Pixel 11 Pro Fold vs. Galaxy Z Fold 8: A Detailed Comparison
summary: Google's Pixel Fold series is a unique player in the foldable phone market. The Pixel 11 Pro Fold maintains its signature passport-style design. This article compares it directly against Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 8.

headline: D’Addario Admits Using AI Music in Promotional Video
summary: Guitar company D'Addario has confessed to using AI-generated music by Suno. The admission follows weeks of denial and mounting speculation. The company initially offered various explanations for the unusual audio.

headline: Google Targets Influencers with Pixel 11 Creator Suite
summary: Google is focusing on content creators to boost the Pixel's market share. The new Pixel lineup features a dedicated Creator Suite. This suite aims to streamline content recording, editing, and publishing.

headline: Mel Gibson Still Wants to Direct Lethal Weapon 5, Despite Hurdles
summary: Mel Gibson confirms he still aims to direct Lethal Weapon 5. The movie project appears to be stuck in 'development hell.' Its future production status remains uncertain.

headline: Jeremy Strong Emailed Zuckerberg for 'Social Reckoning' Role
summary: Actor Jeremy Strong reached out to Mark Zuckerberg for 'The Social Reckoning'. He promised to approach the portrayal of Zuckerberg 'with respect'. Strong acknowledged Zuckerberg as a 'reviled person'.

headline: Made By Google 2026: Get Ready For the Pixel 11
summary: Google's annual Made By Google event is approaching. The Pixel 11 flagship phone is confirmed for unveiling. Expect potential additional surprises beyond the new smartphone.

headline: Preorder Pixel 11, Get Up to $350 in Amazon Gift Cards
summary: Preorders are now open for Google's latest Pixel 11 smartphones. Customers can receive up to $350 in Amazon gift cards. This offer accompanies the upcoming flagship Android devices.

headline: Three Ways to Watch Solar Eclipse Safely Without Glasses
summary: Many stores may be out of solar eclipse glasses. Learn three safe methods to view the spectacle without special eyewear. Household items can be repurposed for safe viewing.

headline: Ann Widdecombe's Loved Ones Gather for Her Funeral
summary: Former MP Ann Widdecombe's funeral was held at Buckfast Abbey. Loved ones gathered in Devon, near her Dartmoor home. A requiem mass marked the solemn service.

headline: Double Killer and Rapist Given Whole Life Sentence
summary: Simon Levy, from Tottenham, received a whole life prison sentence. He was convicted for the murder of two women. Levy also committed the rape of a third victim.

headline: Burnham Considers Disposable BBQ Ban Over Wildfire Risks
summary: The PM is considering a ban on disposable BBQs. This measure aims to reduce the risk of wildfires. It is prompted by the current spell of extremely dry weather.
